title: Uttermost
summary: UT'TERMOST, adjective [utter and most.] Extreme; being in the furthest, greatest or highest degree; as the uttermost extent or end; the uttermost distress. UT'TERMOST, noun The greatest. the uttermost

inlines.v: UT'TERMOST, adjective [utter and most.] Extreme; being in the furthest, greatest or highest degree; as the uttermost extent or end; the uttermost distress. UT'TERMOST, noun The greatest. the uttermost we can do is to be patient. To the uttermost in the most extensive degree; fully. Hebrews 8:1.
